stories.title: Senedd backs cross-party calls to review Welsh funding formula
stories.summary: Senedd Members have backed calls to review Wales’ funding formula to increase fairness and transparency in how the nation is financed. stories.title: School leaders’ union and Welsh Government agree 14 working days of intensive talks over pay and funding
stories.summary: School leaders’ union NAHT Cymru and the Welsh Government have agreed to 14 working days of intensive negotiations to try to settle a dispute over pay, workload and school funding. Councils, as the employers, are represented by the Welsh Local Government Association, and the talks will also cover funding for pupils with additional learning needs

stories.title: One in three Flintshire children live in income deprivation, and that is among the lowest rates in Wales
stories.summary: About one in three children in Flintshire were living in income deprivation in 2024, according to Welsh Government figures. stories.title: Ambulance handover delays still Wales’ “most significant” challenge despite progress, says watchdog
stories.summary: Delayed patient handovers remain the most significant challenge facing the Welsh Ambulance Service despite wider improvements made within the Trust. That is according to a report released today by Healthcare Inspectorate Wales (HIW) focusing on patient flow and handovers, managing operational pressures, patient communication, leadership and governance, and data quality. stories.title: Airbus order from Bangladesh will support jobs ‘from Broughton to Bristol’, says Business Secretary
stories.summary: Biman Bangladesh Airlines has placed a firm order for 10 Airbus aircraft, including four A350-900s, a type whose wings are built at Broughton. The order, announced by Airbus on Wednesday 7 October, also covers six A321neo single-aisle aircraft. Airbus Broughton also makes wings for the A320 family, which includes the A321neo.
